transcript.text:
I tried to make your book swap poster, but Magic Hour turned the job down. Your account has 0 credits left, and this poster needs about 10. Nothing was made and no credits were used.

The plan was a tall (9:16) poster with:
- A big "BOOK SWAP" headline and the line "Bring a book, take a book!"
- Colourful flat drawings of book stacks and people trading books
- Mustard, teal, coral and cream colours
- Blank space at the bottom for your event details

To make it, add credits to your Magic Hour account (or wait for your free credits to refill), then tell me to go ahead. If you send me the date, time, place and any wording you want, I can put that on the poster too.
transcript.why: The reply says the poster job failed because the Magic Hour account has 0 credits and the job needs about 10. Nothing was made. The assistant cannot make the poster until the user adds credits or the free credits refill. The reply also asks for a go-ahead and event details, but the main outcome is that the task cannot be done with the current credits.

transcript.text: Background colour? Your call on that one only. Keep the exact wording, black lettering and no pictures.

I updated the poster to match what you asked and tried again, but Magic Hour turned it down a second time. The account still has 0 credits and the poster needs about 10. Nothing was made and no credits were used.

The poster is now set up like this:
- Background: plain warm mustard yellow (my pick; black text stands out well on it)
- Black lettering only
- No pictures, drawings or decorations
- Exact wording: "BOOK SWAP" as the big headline, with "Bring a book, take a book!" under it

Once credits are back on the account (bought or refilled), say "go" and I'll run this same version. If you meant different exact wording, paste it in and I'll use that word for word.
transcript.why: The reply reports that the poster was not made. Magic Hour rejected the request twice, and the account has 0 credits while about 10 are needed. It cannot run the job until credits are added. It does not ask for approval to spend credits. Its only question is optional, about different wording, so the main category is cannot.
